steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Roulecca? Roulecca?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Hmm?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: What's going on, Daddy? I haven't slept enough...

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Shhhh... keep it down.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Can you play a game with Daddy?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Yes!

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Quiet!

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Yay! Roulecca loves playing games.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: The rules are simple. From this moment on, you have to hide here. Don't say a single word or let out any sound until 8 pm. After that, you can come out.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Ahh... that's too hard, Daddy!

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Your prize will be this revolver that you've always wanted. It's different from what you have now, see?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Wow! T-then I will play! I will definitely win!

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Then from now on, don't make any sounds no matter what happens. Understand?

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: If you try to play any tricks, don't even think about having the revolver for the rest of your life.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Mmm!

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Daddy's going to leave now, okay? You have to hide well! You'll definitely win with your luck. Daddy believes you.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Mmm!
As the closet closes, gunshots can be heard from the outside.
The gunshots continue ringing, and the young girl tries several times to push open the closet door. However, each time, she will remember her agreement with dad and draw her hand back.
Be it moaning, unknown voices, or sly laughter, she does not open the closet door.
The young girl is very obedient. After all, the prize is something she has yearned for.
The time is 8 pm. The young girl repeatedly calls for her father's name to ask him to open the door for her.
However, there isn't anyone coming over to congratulate her on her victory.
Usually, Aunt Popper would be the first to congratulate her with her favorite lollipop whenever she won a bet with her father.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Daddy? Daddy?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Roulecca wins this time! I'm coming for my prize! You cannot renege on it...
The young girl pushes the door but suddenly finds that something is blocking it.
She opens the door with all her might for the sake of her prize.
The door opens, and at that moment, she is shocked.
Her father's cold body collapses on her.
His body is covered with bullet holes, but he used it to protect Roulecca.
The young girl looks over her father's shoulder and sees what is beyond the closet.
Each and every member of Four-leaf Clover has fallen in front of her.
Trembling, she puts her hand on her father's cheek, hoping for him to speak to her.
But it is impossible as the man is not breathing.
In his hand is the revolver that he promised to give to the girl.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Daddy... Daddy...

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Everyone...
The girl's voice fades away...
You seem to have dreamed about a young girl and her father.
You open your eyes.
You find yourself in a bed in the Bureau with Nightingale standing next to you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, how do you feel? This is the fifth day you have spent in the Bureau's recuperation room. You are expected to be able to return to work in four days.
It's been five days since you were injured in the operation.
You try to move your right arm, but it still stings.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Please don't push yourself too hard, Chief.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But for the antidote provided by Sinner Roulecca, your convalescence would have been extended by another month.
How did she do it? She was so badly hurt at that time.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: According to our investigation at the scene, you subconsciously unleashed the shackles after you saved her life.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: That activated Sinner Roulecca's abilities again, which enabled her to get the antidote from those gangsters.
You remember the objective of the mission—to keep the informant alive.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Only one. Unfortunately, he doesn't seem to know any more about the mania weapon trade.
To your surprise, Roulecca didn't kill the one who threw the gas bomb at her.
You ask Nightingale to send some documents in as usual. If you don't deal with them now, they'll pile up when you're back in the office.
Nightingale nods and leaves the room.
There aren't many documents sent in today—around two to three files.
It only takes you an hour to finish reading and commenting on them. You leave a message for Nightingale to pick them up at a later time.
After finishing your work, you take a look at the time. It is exactly 10 am, which is the time you agreed with her.
Seems that this Sinner is not punctual today.
Maybe she got into some trouble, being the troublemaker she is. It wouldn't be surprising if she were kept in close confinement by Nightingale.
You stretch with the arm that can move and walk towards the window. When you pull back the curtains to enjoy the morning sun...
You see a giant face pressed against the window.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Good morning, Chief!
At that moment, you feel the urge to kick the brat down.
Yet you still open the window and let her in.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Can you help Roulecca peel the apple, Chief? My hands are full of bandages...
Roulecca does not see this place as a hospital ward at all.
She said she would visit you every day but turns out the patient is the one fluttering around.

options: How come you're so late today?

choices.text: How come you're so late today?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Umm... I wanted to come earlier, but I had something to take care of.
What is it? You didn't get into trouble again, right?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Don't be so biased against me, Chief!
Roulecca puffs out her cheeks.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I stopped in time that day!
You feel like keeping lecturing Roulecca, but at least she saved your life in that mission.
Then I guess it's your loss this time.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmph! You're so mean, Chief! You keep imposing these weird rules on me!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: And I keep feeling like I'm not as lucky when I'm near you.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Ahhhhhh, don't say anything anymore! I heard nothing, I heard nothing!
Shhh... we need to be quiet here.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Okay...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: How about... I lost today because I failed to arrive by 10 am?
So it's my turn to ask a question today.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmph, bring it on. I'm not afraid of you.
Did you play games with your family like this before?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Yes.
Roulecca, who lost the bet, sits quietly on the edge of your bed like an obedient child.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: My dad would drop everything to play games with me and make me happy. It made me feel I was the luckiest child in the world.
So you've been lucky since you were a child?
You listen to Roulecca while continuing to move your hand. The apple is soon peeled.
Roulecca grabs the apple and takes a big bite, then continues talking about her past.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Of course not, idiot Chief. All that "luck" came from my dad and everyone at Four-leaf Clover.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: My dad was the leader of Four-leaf Clover. Mom passed away shortly after I was born, so everyone in the gang helped in raising me. They were all my family.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: They really spoiled me. No matter what I asked for, they would try their best to get it for me.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Once, I realized I had lost my favorite teddy bear.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I was very sad because it was a birthday gift from Uncle Jack. But in the end, he managed to find it back.
Is it the one you carry around with you?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Yes. Uncle Jack told me, "This bear is your lucky charm. It's your four-leaf clover and your lucky horseshoe."

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: As long as I have it, I'm the luckiest girl in the world. No matter how grave the situation is, I will be able to get through it safely.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: At that time, the thing about my luck was a lie. A gentle lie of good intentions made by those who loved me the most.
How did they do it?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: And here's another file I think that might interest you.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: When I was shopping but forgot to bring my wallet, I would always meet Aunt Popper who happened to be "out shopping."

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: At the beginning, I thought I was really lucky. But after growing up, I learned the truth behind my luck.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: But the candy that Charlie gave me was really delicious. Even now, I can remember how it tasted.
How's it compared to the food at the Bureau?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Well... The Bureau's food is good.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: But I can't help missing the old days when my family and I could eat a warm meal together.
The sunlight falls on Roulecca's back, adding a hint of shadow to her.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Too bad I will never have the chance again.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: If I were a bit braver... would there have been a better ending...?
The sadness of her family's passing is like a swamp that traps Roulecca. This time you decide to give her a hand.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Ow, Chief! What are you doing?!
Let's make another bet.
I bet you will no longer exact revenge alone.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hahahaha, Chief. You're gonna lose soon.
That's because you're going to punish those gangsters with me.
But I am different from your family. I will not spoil you.
If you were to sneak off for revenge and I caught you...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: What would happen?

options: I would flick you hard in the forehead.
I would put you in solitary confinement.

choices.text: I would flick you hard in the forehead.
I would put you in solitary confinement.

steps.content: Get it? Last time you said I was not being serious, but this time I am!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Haha, the Chief's vibes.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I promise you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, Chief?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: There's an emergency.
Go ahead, I'm listening.
Right after you finish making the promise with Roulecca, an urgent transmission comes from Nightingale.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The Sinner Roulecca has once again escaped from confinement. We speculate from their tracks that she is near your ward.
Is that why you didn't enter from the front door today?
You look over at Roulecca, who is sneakily opening the window.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Ha... haha... there were some special circumstances.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I-I'll see you later, Chief. Don't forget our promise!
Roulecca pulls the window open and leaps down.
ROULECCA!
